name: gltf-model-physical
adaptedFrom: original — four dark dielectric spheres loaded by three's GLTFLoader and the native glTF loader: plain standard, KHR_materials_ior 2.2, KHR_materials_specular (factor 0.7, orange colour), and Midway's shape (ior 0, read as 1000, grey specular colour 0.3). Each extension makes a MeshPhysicalMaterial whose highlight differs from the standard sphere's.
